source.selection: 2016 fixed before viewing year-specific height effects; reference metadata show 37 tags started in 2016 (highest single-year deployment start count), four colony study-site codes.
source.universe: One Movebank source, do not count same tracks imported via GBIF/OBIS/Zenodo updates as independent replications. 162 individual reference rows across 2013-2023, not 162 simultaneously observed in 2016.

meteorology.independent_source: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ECMWF CERRA Europe, 5 km resolution in 2016)
meteorology.spatial_link: For each of the four source-defined study-site codes, take median deploy-on coordinates among 2016-deployed birds from the published reference file (no GPS altitude or outcome). Request one daily 24-hour hourly wind series per site; DO NOT assert weather at animal's position.
meteorology.day_statistic: mean of 24 hourly CERRA wind_speed_100m values; days missing >20% hourly wind excluded as meteorological unavailable
meteorology.regimes: Within each site x each month, lower <=25th and upper >=75th percentile of all May-Jul 2016 calendar-day mean wind, computed without any tracking results. Middle 50% excluded from contrast.
meteorology.unavailable_fields: CERRA 2016 boundary_layer_height returned all null; exclude it rather than silently imputing.
meteorology.permissions: Public noncommercial source; rate limits and required attribution to be maintained in manuscripts.

GPS_structural_gate.event_choice: For each bird-date five-minute bin select the earliest GPS fix that passes only speed/time/x-y/provider outlier checks, prior to height handling.
GPS_structural_gate.map_bird_to_site: Try identity crosswalk between event individual-local-identifier / tag-local-identifier and reference animal-id / tag-id / tag-serial-no. Accept only one-to-one, source-supported mappings: no guessing. If no >=95% mapping, site-level wind test unavailable.
GPS_structural_gate.horizontal_grid: EPSG:32631, 5km cells; choose same-cell own-other-day and cross-individual records independently before altitude.
GPS_structural_gate.nonwind_source_min: At least 10 unique birds with >=2 days each having >=50 five-minute flight bins and at least 10 self-other-day plus 10 other-bird-other-day records per evaluation cell.
GPS_structural_gate.wind_context_min: At least 10 birds have >=2 separately sampled days in BOTH low and high site-month CERRA wind regimes, with >=20 5min flight bins per day in a cell they also visit on another day; do not relax if unavailable.

biological_question: In an independently tracked, multiple-colony gull cohort, does site-level wind regime predict within-bird vertical probability-shape reorganization across separate flight days beyond stable bird identity and horizontal occupancy?
prediction_class: Context-dependent vertical distribution shapes are more transferable within similar wind regimes than across regimes, conditional on the same bird and coarse horizontal cell.
not_allowed_claims: ERA5/CERRA regional wind represents local updraft at each GPS point
Behavioral flight class measured by speed alone
A 162-individual macro outcome is already observed
next_stage: Run source+meteorology ID-crosswalk and x-y support without opening altitude. If gate passes freeze a subsequent day-heldout primary; else retain structural no-support and pivot to a different independent archive.
